name: streamlink-end-to-end-utility-provenance
instr:
Streamlink cannot explain how stream results are derived across utilities, HTTP handling, validation, plugin discovery, and extraction. Add opt-in, end-to-end provenance without changing ordinary behavior.

Traced operations keep occurrence order, stable IDs, valid parents, and one ancestry across utility boundaries. Immutable, isolated snapshots serialize deterministically through `to_dict(self)` and apply one `ProvenancePolicy`, redacting payloads and query values. `ProvenanceError` is a Exception; established exceptions retain their type and expose partial work through `ProvenanceError.report`. `UtilityProvenance(policy=None)` and `snapshot(self)` capture work during or after execution without later mutation.

JSON, HTML, XML, and query-string parsing record format-specific preparation, decoding, schema, success, and failure, including XML declarations in byte HTML. `search_dict(data, key, *, provenance=None)` records match paths when yielded and termination without consuming the remaining input. Cache tracing distinguishes misses, hits, replacement, promotion, and eviction while preserving capacity, laziness, and identity. `absolute_url(baseurl, url, *, provenance=None)` distinguishes absolute reuse from relative composition and records origins without unrelated query values. `load_module(name, path, override=False, *, provenance=None)` distinguishes finder lookup, fresh execution, cached reuse, and override execution while preserving module identity, state, and errors.
